profile_text.body:
Greylock Partners is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, founded in 1965. According to its website, it describes itself as a leading venture capital firm in Silicon Valley that serves as "early partners of remarkable teams building companies that matter." The firm emphasizes a selective approach to investing, with each Greylock partner making only one or two new investments a year in order to bring full attention, network, and resources to every partnership.

The company maintains a presence across California law exposure with 220 tracked cases in the state. Greylock does not currently track specific AI products or maintain MCP server registry entries in the held facts database.
